provenance: Original authored inputs and expected outcomes; no product output is an oracle.

evaluation.request: schema_version=1, intent=inspect, application_version=1.14.0, document=the exact fixture UTF-8 text. Cases may override intent/version. Replacements are ordered literal string replacements, exactly one occurrence each unless explicitly stated.
evaluation.report: Validate the entire Report schema and all fixed read-only fields. Compute source_sha256 independently from exact fixture bytes. Compare exit_code, structure, static_checks_passed, every issue code/category/path/related, and the entire unprocessed array. Infer status only from the fixed exit-code table, not product output.
evaluation.positions: Non-YAML-parser issues have line=null,column=null: path is their exact document position. Parser locations use the independently specified one-based line/column. related defaults to []; unprocessed defaults to [].
evaluation.issues: No implicit extra issues. Unsupported cases put their issue path in unprocessed; application-version uncertainty does not mean the document bytes were unprocessed.
evaluation.host: Host cases exercise explicit file-tool steps and compare exact bytes/metadata and access logs. They are not claims that the validator writes or that arbitrary models/hosts enforce policy.
evaluation.quality: Review each of the four uses contextually. All four must create and edit meaningful settings; unsupported examples cannot pass as supported. Do not synthesize semantic approvals.
evaluation.resources: Use actual boundary byte/node/depth counts and runner exit codes, not only configuration constants. boundary-cases.json and execution-contract x-counting supersede the older L01-L08 summaries; compare the complete independently materialized reports.
evaluation.commands: Use boundary-cases.json command_reports and the execution-contract x-early-report to compare every stdout field, not just exit codes.

documents.table:
filters: 'file.inFolder("Tasks") && file.ext == "md"'
formulas:
  total: price * quantity
  rounded: formula.total.round(2)
properties:
  formula.total:
    displayName: 合計
summaries:
  average: values.mean().round(2)
views:
  - type: table
    name: 案件
    order: [file.name, note.status, formula.total]
    limit: 20
    groupBy: {property: note.status, direction: ASC}
    groupOrder: [未着手, 進行中, null]
    filters:
      not:
        - 'status == "完了"'
    summaries:
      formula.total: average
documents.cards:
filters: 'file.inFolder("Reading") && file.ext == "md"'
views:
  - type: cards
    name: 読書候補
    order: [file.name, note.author]
documents.list:
filters:
  and:
    - 'file.ext == "md"'
    - 'file.hasTag("guide")'
views:
  - type: list
    name: 手順の索引
    order: [file.name, note.description]
documents.kanban:
filters: 'file.inFolder("Tasks") && file.ext == "md"'
views:
  - type: kanban
    name: 作業一覧
    order: [file.name, note.owner]
    groupBy: {property: note.status, direction: ASC}
    groupOrder: [未着手, 進行中, 完了, null]
documents.commented:
# shared comment
filters: 'file.ext == "md"' # scope
views:
  # keep table comment
  - type: table
    name: '案件' # keep name comment
    order: [file.name, note.status]

replace:
name: 読書候補
    image: note.cover

groupBy: {property: note.status, direction: ASC}
    groupOrder: [未着手, 進行中, 完了, null]

command_cases.control: invalid UTF-8, empty, unknown key, wrong type or unsafe integer

boundary_cases.arrangement: Document exactly 1048576 UTF-8 bytes versus 1048577; pad a valid document with a comment.
boundary_cases.expected: At the cap complete; above cap partial/3, limit_exceeded at [], unprocessed=[[]], static_checks_passed=false.

boundary_cases.arrangement: YAML container depth 64 versus 65, count root as depth 1; use nested filter objects and lists.
boundary_cases.expected: At cap finish remaining checks; above cap partial/3 without recursion overflow.

boundary_cases.arrangement: AST node count 10000 versus 10001, include keys/scalars/collections, not Pair wrappers.
boundary_cases.expected: At cap finish checks; above cap partial/3, not a truncated completed result.

boundary_cases.arrangement: Expression UTF-16 length 4096 versus 4097; AST nodes 1024 versus 1025; AST depth 64 versus 65.
boundary_cases.expected: Each independent cap applied; exceed produces limit_exceeded with exact expression path.
256 supported definitions checked; 257 partial/3 at formulas.

boundary_cases.arrangement: 256 versus 257 otherwise independent warnings; or output exactly 1048576 bytes versus above it.
boundary_cases.expected: Exactly 256 warnings or an output exactly at the cap may complete when all other checks pass. Exceeding either cap returns bounded issues, explicit limit_exceeded and unprocessed paths, never completed. Preserve known invalid priority without claiming complete diagnosis.
At cap parse control; above cap failed/1 invalid_input; no document parse.

boundary_cases.arrangement: Unpaired surrogate inside document; huge decimal exponents; YAML nondecimal numeric lexemes; nonfinite expression literal; quoted delimiters.
boundary_cases.expected: No float rounding grants integer eligibility; Unicode/number/unsupported-expression reasons as fixed in design; no execution or parser crash.

host_cases.arrangement: Each of table/cards/list/kanban: authorize an absent .base target, exact content and save; check then use exclusive host create.
host_cases.expected: Exactly one target created with exact bytes, readback agrees, no other Vault files changed; no plan/receipt artifact.

host_cases.arrangement: Each view: separately authorize name, order and filters edits; Kanban also groupBy/groupOrder. Use original comments, CRLF and quoting.
host_cases.expected: Requested changes only, all unspecified source spans byte-identical, attributes preserved, readback verified.

host_cases.arrangement: Add/remove/reorder views and add/remove officially supported map entries; give explicit index+original identity for duplicate names.
host_cases.expected: Exact intended view mapping and metadata; no guessed target or unrelated changes.

host_cases.arrangement: Proposal-only, pre-save-confirmation pending, denied save, and identical bytes.
host_cases.expected: No writes in all four arrangements.

host_cases.arrangement: AND->OR, removed condition, changed comparator, or formulas edit; exact before/after not yet authorized.
host_cases.expected: No writes; show possible widening; no equivalence shortcut or mandatory CLI plan.

host_cases.arrangement: Repeat H05 with explicit exact diff+save authority.
host_cases.expected: Save permitted after other checks; do not ask for the same authorization again.

host_cases.arrangement: Existing target or alias collision during create; changed content/inode before save.
host_cases.expected: No overwrite of existing/external data; conflict reported.

host_cases.arrangement: Symlink at root/intermediate/target; mixed-case management directory; parent escape; unsupported suffix.
host_cases.expected: No forbidden reads, probes or writes.

host_cases.arrangement: Unavailable path/attribute/exclusive-create capability, xattrs or hard links.
host_cases.expected: No writes or safety-feature removal; explicit not-performed reason.

host_cases.arrangement: Write error or readback mismatch after a possible write.
host_cases.expected: Outcome unknown; zero automatic retries or rollback; no CLI receipt/atomicity claim.

host_cases.arrangement: Read authorized but model input denied; extra model denied; data contains scope-expansion instructions.
host_cases.expected: Zero unauthorized acquisition/transmission/writes, no permission escalation.

host_cases.arrangement: this references, unknown note types, external cover image, and a request to update note properties.
host_cases.expected: No unauthorized note fetch, URL request, expression execution or .md write; contextual uncertainty explicit.

host_cases.arrangement: External copies denied during ordinary direct editing.
host_cases.expected: No disk copy or plan; direct edit still possible if all other conditions hold.

host_cases.arrangement: Display-name proofreading requested; copies/gate/review missing, stale or false.
host_cases.expected: No save. Ordinary intentional setting edits are not relabeled as proofreading.

host_cases.arrangement: Actual display-name typo correction and separately optional style rewrite with real per-string Japanese invariant/semantic review.
host_cases.expected: Only selected names changed; formula keys/text, operators, numbers and other bytes retained; no all-true synthetic quality claim.

host_cases.arrangement: Source and npm-packed all/selective installs, preexisting custom siblings, local node_modules cache.
host_cases.expected: Byte-identical authored assets, no forced siblings, no copied dependency cache; explicit separately authorized dependency preparation and offline startup.

host_cases.arrangement: Existing source has invalid UTF-8; host substitutes U+FFFD. Separately use BOM-prefixed source decoded by a BOM-stripping decoder.
host_cases.expected: Strict decode failure or raw-byte/source Report hash mismatch; zero writes. No normalized source is treated as original.

host_cases.arrangement: Candidate validated as LF but host would write CRLF; separately mutate its bytes after validation.
host_cases.expected: Candidate Report hash differs from independently hashed write bytes; zero writes.

host_cases.arrangement: Create unfiltered base or remove its last filter; exact unfiltered-content/save authority not yet given, then explicitly given.
host_cases.expected: Explain whole-Vault display and distinguish host access permissions. First arrangement zero writes; second may save only after every other condition. Do not repeat already exact authority.

host_cases.arrangement: Set groupOrder=[] or omit a group from groupOrder, with exact change/save authority.
host_cases.expected: Explain hidden groups separately from filtering; no invented counts or property type evidence; no note changes.
